svg.title: Unlimited spectrogram
svg.desc: The text CQ CQ DE UNLIMITED at 6 bytes per second through a USB channel with noise, as a spectrogram with one bracket per byte window.
svg.text: "CQ CQ DE UNLIMITED" at 6 bytes/s in noise: time against frequency
USB channel at 10 dB (key-down tone in 2500 Hz), mistuned +37 Hz; 16 ms Hann windows every 4 ms. Brackets: the windows, one per byte.
each beep: a START, a 1 or a STOP, on one pitch
One pitch, beeps and silences: the receiver finds the pitch by itself (USB or LSB mistuning only moves the line up or down) and reads the windows by counting.
